goal: After perfect no-gradient dual-view edge identification, authorize one bounded experiment that tests only specialist activation and directional residual reasoning.

objective.causal: field-selection CE + margin + BCE on actual specialist_logit target 1
objective.preservation: frozen-parent KL + BCE on same specialist_logit target 0

method_lessons: Once a boundary is proven solved, freeze it during the next experiment so failure remains localizable.
Separate edge identity from specialist activation and directional reasoning when evidence shows those subproblems have different difficulty.
Supervise the exact runtime activation variable rather than a proxy router.
Do not optimize a perfect DEV edge rank merely because a calibration parameter exists.
